claims.statement: Tom Allen was at the ringside when Sullivan and Kilrain fought with bare fists at Richburg.
claims.excerpt: When Kilrain and Sullivan fought with bare fists at Richburg I heard old Tom Allen say at the ring side

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: They fight like a pair of old wash women.

notes: The article gives no year; 1889 is the year of the Sullivan-Kilrain fight. The hint's travel kind is changed to other, since he was a spectator at ringside.
